title: Protocol for Students who Test COVID-19-positive with Self-administered Antigen Rapid Tests Prior to School Academic Assessment
what_it_is: Protocol for Students who Test COVID-19-positive with Self-administered Antigen Rapid Tests Prior to School Academic Assessment

sections.label: ART-positive students self-isolation exit rules
sections.summary: ART-positive students self-isolate at home and may exit after 72 hours with a negative test, or later depending on vaccination and age.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: ART-positive students who are well or with mild symptoms are to adhere to MOH's Protocol 2 and self-isolate at home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: After 72 hours, such students may exit self-isolation and resume normal activities with an ART-negative result.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Otherwise, vaccinated students or students below 12 years old may automatically exit self-isolation after Day 7.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Partially-vaccinated or unvaccinated students aged 12 and above may automatically exit self-isolation after Day 14.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Such students would not be required to produce a medical certificate to cover their absence, even if they have a weighted assessment (WA) or school examination.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: However, schools may request to have sight of the photo evidence of the ART-positive test result.

sections.label: Missed weighted assessments handling
sections.summary: Students who miss a weighted assessment or school examination for valid reasons have results rebased using other components.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would also like to say that, I guess a concern might be around the fact that the student might have a WA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, should a WA be a factor, then when students miss this WA, the practice is actually for them to complete the task as practice papers, because we do not wish for the school-based examinations to be high stakes and to contribute to too much stress.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And students who miss a WA or the school examination for valid reasons, such as being ill because of COVID-19, they would have their results rebased, taking into consideration other WAs or other components of the school examination.
